about: Established in 1991, Fiber forms was one of the first companies in UAE that was into in the field of GRP products and achieved a remarkable name in GRP shades, bath tubs, swimming pools, advertising samples, kiosks, ship and yachts repairs,GRP Products of artistic and architectural touch etc.Over the years, our portfolio has increased and we are now into all types of shade structures, steel fabrication, aluminium...

We have done more than 5000+ projects in UAE over the last three decades. Our eminent clients includes Schools, Universities, 4 Star & 5 Star Hotels, Resorts, Shopping malls, Showrooms, government organizations, RTA, Dubai Police, Abudhabi Defence, Drydocks, Religious Places, Ships/Yachts and more.
